verdict.rationale: Turso officially states it ships SDKs in TypeScript, Python, Rust, and Go. There is first-party SDK documentation, including a TS quickstart with push()/pull() sync, an SDK introduction, and a fetch-only `@tursodatabase/serverless` package for edge runtimes. It also has a Next.js guide and SDK authorization docs covering scoped tokens, fine-grained permissions, and JWKS. missing for 10: in-depth evidence for the Python/Rust/Go SDKs beyond the one-line claim, and independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
